title: In vitro ubiquitination and degradation of bacteria-purified human histone H2B by the nucleoli fractions
protocol: Take the competent BL21 cells from the -80°C freezer and thaw the cells on ice.
Mix 2 μL of GST-H2B plasmids (approximately 1 μg) with 20 μL of BL21 competent cells in a microcentrifuge tube.
Gently mix the cells and the plasmids.
Place the tube with cells on ice for 30 min.
Heat shock the tube by placing it into a 42°C water bath for 90 s.
Put the tube back on ice for 2 min.
Add 800 μL LB medium (without antibiotic) to the tube and incubate in a bacterial shaker at 250 rpm for 60 min at 37°C.
Centrifuge the tube at 4000 rpm for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend it by adding 100 μL LB liquid medium (without antibiotic).
Transfer the entire amount on one 10 cm LB plate containing 100 μg/mL kanamycin antibiotic.
Use a spreader to spread the sample evenly over the surface of a section of the plate.
Drag through the first section with a fresh, sterile spreader and spread the bacteria over a second section of the plate.
Repeat the step to create the third section.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 1 hour.
Invert the plate and continue incubation at 37°C for approximately 12 hours.
Select a single colony from the LB agar plate using a sterile pipette tip.
Drop the tip containing the colony into 3 mL LB medium with 100 μg/mL kanamycin.
Grow the cells in a bacterial shaker at 250 rpm and 37°C for approximately 12 hours.
Incubate 2 mL of cell culture into 200 mL LB medium with kanamycin (dilution ratio 1:100).
Grow the cell culture in a bacterial shaker at 250 rpm and 37°C until OD600 ≈ 0.6.
Add IPTG to achieve a final concentration of 0.2 mM to the cell culture.
Incubate the cell culture with IPTG in a bacterial shaker at 250 rpm and 20°C for approximately 12 hours.
Centrifuge cells at 1000 g for 5 minutes (use 45 mL of cell culture per 50 mL centrifuge tube).
Discard the supernatant and keep the pellet.
Repeat steps to pellet all 200 mL of cell culture four more times if necessary.
Resuspend the final pellet with 3 mL PBS supplemented with 1 mM PMSF.
Sonicate the pellet solution with 1 min on and 3 min off intervals using a sonicator at 50% power in an ice/water slurry bath for approximately 30 minutes.
Transfer the cells to a 50 mL centrifuge tube and add 17 mL PBS supplemented with 1 mM PMSF.
Sonicate again with 1 min on and 3 min off intervals using a sonicator at 50% power in an ice/water slurry bath until the mixture becomes clear.
Centrifuge the lysate at 4°C at 12000 rpm for 10 minutes.
Collect the supernatant, which contains the target protein.
Save the supernatant and the pellet for analysis.
Prepare the glutathione sepharose 4B beads (steps 20–23).
Gently shake the bottle of glutathione sepharose 4B to resuspend the slurry.
Transfer 1 mL beads to a 5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min.
Carefully discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads by adding 4 mL PBS and invert to mix.
Sediment the medium by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 min.
Carefully discard the supernatant.
Repeat step two more times.
Mix the supernatant from step with the prepared beads from step together in a 50 mL tube and rotate gently for approximately 12 h at 4°C.
Centrifuge it at 4°C at 500 g for 5 min to collect beads, carefully discard the supernatant until there are approximately 3 mL solution left.
Resuspend the beads gently.
Transfer the solution to a 5 mL centrifuge tube.
Sediment the beads by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 min.
Carefully discard the supernatant.
Wash the beads by adding 1 mL PBS supplemented with 1 mM PMSF and resuspend gently.
Rotate at 4°C for 10 min.
Sediment the beads by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 min.
Carefully discard the supernatant.
Repeat steps two more times for a total of three washes.
Elute the bound protein by adding 2 mL elution buffer and rotate it at 4°C for 6 h.
Centrifuge at 4°C at 2000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Save the supernatant at -80°C for analysis.
Wash cells gently with 3 mL prewarmed PBS.
Discard the PBS completely.
Add 1 mL prewarmed trypsin-EDTA solution and incubate at 37°C for approximately 1 minute.
Transfer the cells to a 5 mL conical tube after adding 2 mL prewarmed complete growth medium.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 1 mL hypotonic buffer A supplemented with 1 mM PMSF to the cell pellet.
Resuspend cells and incubate on ice for 30 minutes.
Transfer the solution into a prechilled glass Dounce homogenizer on ice.
Stroke up and down promptly and steadily approximately 10 times on ice.
Centrifuge at 220 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the nuclei with 500 μL S1 solution supplemented with 1 mM PMSF at 4°C.
Add 500 μL S2 solution supplemented with 1 mM PMSF to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add the S1 solution of step 38 to S2 solution carefully and slowly along the tube wall.
Centrifuge at 220 g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend pellets in 500 μL S2 solution supplemented with 1 mM PMSF.
Sonicate in an ice/water slurry bath at 40% power six times, each time for 10 s on and 30 s off.
Take a new 1.5 mL tube and add 500 μL S3 solution supplemented with 1 mM PMSF.
Carefully add the sonicated sample along the tube wall to form two separated layers of S2 at the top and S3 at the bottom.
Centrifuge at 3000 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Save the supernatant containing the nucleoplasm fraction in another microcentrifuge tube.
Resuspend the nucleoli pellet with 500 μL S2 supplemented with 1 mM PMSF.
Centrifuge at 4°C at 1430 g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Repeat step of resuspending and centrifuging the nucleoli pellet two more times.
Resuspend the nucleoli pellet in 500 μL RIPA solution supplemented with 1 mM PMSF.
Perform Western blotting analyses to determine the purification efficiency of the nucleolar fractions and non-nucleolar fractions (cytoplasmic + nucleopasmic).
Store the nucleoli, nucleoplasm fraction, and cytoplasmic fraction at −80°C for later analysis if long-term preservation is needed.
Incubate the established reaction systems at 37°C for 20 hours.
Keep the temperature at 37°C during incubation.
Add 5 × SDS-PAGE loading buffer to the samples.
Analyze protein expression in the samples by Western blot.
Mix GST-H2B (1 μg) with nucleoli, RIPA buffer, and MG132.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C for 20 hours.
Pull down the samples using Sepharose 4B beads.
Subject the pulled-down samples to Western blot analyses.
Mix GST-H2B (1 μg) with cytoplasmic+nucleoplasmic fraction, RIPA buffer, and MG132.
Incubate this mixture at 37°C for 20 hours.
Pull down these samples using Sepharose 4B beads.
Subject the pulled-down samples to Western blot analyses.
Keep the temperature at 37°C.
Prepare 50 μL glutathione sepharose 4B beads according to steps 20–23.
Add the solution from step 52 to the bead pellet from step 53 and resuspend the pellet by pipetting several times gently and slowly.
Rotate at 4°C slowly for approximately 12 h.
Collect the beads by sedimentation at 4°C at 500 g for 5 min.
Wash the beads by adding 1 mL PBS supplemented with 1 mM PMSF and resuspend gently.
Rotate at 4°C for 10 min.
Sediment the beads by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 min.
Carefully discard the supernatant.
Repeat washing two more times for a total of three washes.
Add 300 μL elution buffer to the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet by pipetting several times gently and slowly.
Prepare elution buffer just before use.
Rotate at 4°C for 6 h.
Sediment the pellet by centrifugation at 4°C at 500 g for 5 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 5 × SDS-PAGE loading buffer to the supernatant.
Analyze the protein expression by Western blot.
